messages:
nina: Heads-up: legal + privacy approved a global exit policy update. Need handbook copy, APAC time-window notes, and the compliance training + tracker plan.

rahul: Key differences: retention clock starts on termination date local to the region; EU/UK maintain existing GDPR deletion windows; APAC needs a 48-hour deprovision buffer for local payroll reconciliation.

anya: Draft handbook blurb should call out region-specific timing and alumni data access (30 days default purge, opt-in for short investigatory retention up to 12 months). Also note who can request reactivation.

lee: Ops: for exports please snapshot these fields 24h prior (or 48h in APAC): employee_id,name,email,office_location,primary_repo_access,last_login,device_serial. CLI example for infra: `redwood-admin export --user 3210 --fields employee_id,name,email,office_location,primary_repo_access,last_login,device_serial --output /tmp/offboard-3210.csv`.

olivia: Tracking: CSV columns -> manager,employee_id,region,opt_in(Y/N),training_ack(Y/N),ack_ts,followup_needed(Y/N). Will auto-ingest 1-click manager acks. Need form id for e-sign: OFF-2026-APAC1.

nina: Managers: we'll record a 10-min regional microtraining and require completion within 7 days of a departure; APAC managers get an extra note about payroll hold windows. We'll publish a one-slide checklist + FAQ.

hr-bot: Reminder set - publish handbook update to #people-ops-docs and schedule regional recordings for 2026-09-14 (US/EU/APAC windows).

rahul: One policy ask: include an escrow contact for legal holds and a short escalation matrix for high-risk departures. I'll drop the contact list in the doc.

anya: I'll draft the handbook paragraph + FAQ and post in #people-ops-docs for signoff. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
